query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_companies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN enrichmentStatus != 'enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_enrichment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fitScore IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_fit_score,
  SUM(CASE WHEN urgencyScore IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_urgency,
  SUM(CASE WHEN briefData IS NULL OR briefData = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_brief,
  SUM(CASE WHEN salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_sales_approach
FROM companies 
WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003);
